pages.title: M-Brane
pages.text: A two-dimensional membrane from M-theory, the eleven-dimensional framework in which strings are the edges of membranes. A brane like this could host an entire universe on its surface, with gravity alone leaking into the Bulk. It is a sheet of light that ripples when I breathe on it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wove a D-Brane Sheet with a G2 Manifold and a String Coupling Crystal on the String Resonance Loom, turning the coupling up until the strings fused into a membrane. Eleven dimensions, counted twice to make sure.
